notes.title: ⚠️Apr 16 (Wed) NEW PATCH UPDATE Notice ⚠️
notes.content:
[h2]PATCH UPDATE[/h2]
[h3]Game Update[/h3]
[list]
[*] Hero Dungeons 'Hero: Quicksand Garden' and 'Hero: Sand Spirit Sanctuary' are now open. Lv60 players have four chances per day to talk to the Spring Jade City NPC 'Bear Paw Explorer - Benya' to enter the hero dungeon. [*] Fixed the issue where pet and Pulu skills with the same effect could not stack.  
[/list][list]
[*] Fixed abnormal player count under certain conditions in the Snow Corridor Arena.
[/list][list]
[*] Fixed the issue where players could not re-enter the battlefield after leaving midway.
[/list][list]
[*] Fixed the main quest 'LV60. Escort the King to Find Balan' where the report NPC might not appear.
[/list]

[h3]Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted and optimized text display issues in various interfaces.
[/list][list]
[*] Adjusted the position of special effect titles so their height will no longer be blocked by the title name or guild name.
[/list][list]
[*] Optimized the TIP descriptions for 'Hundred Refined Spring (Pet Refinement)' and 'Pet Rebirth Potion.'
[/list]

For detailed version update content, please refer to [url=https://www.x-legend.com/online/glorydestiny-reborn/en/news_in.php?nid=24827]Notice from Official Site[/url]

notes.title: ⚠️Apr 9 (Wed) NEW PATCH UPDATE Notice ⚠️
notes.content:
[h2]PATCH UPDATE[/h2]
[h3]Game Update[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Snowhall Arena "3v3 Mode" is now open. Players above level 50 can form a party or register solo. Battles can be accessed via the battlefield button on the radar map daily from 16:00~16:30 and 21:00~21:30. Each side starts with a battle flag in their respective starting region. Destroying the opponent's battle flag and returning to your starting region with the "Battle Flag State" grants 1 point. The first team to score 2 points wins. Each member of the winning team receives 5 Stellar Combat Tokens, while the lose one receive 3 Stellar Combat Tokens.
[/list][list]
[*] Added Support Helper feature 【Cancel the second confirmation for selling high-quality Items in the Store】, can be set in the Pet tab.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where skill effects persisted after logging out and back in while pets were fused or in Puru resonance state.  
[/list][list]
[*] Fixed an issue where pet experiment attempts displayed abnormally after ceasing nurturing in the Pet Nursery.
[/list][list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the Hao Xiang Tu title 【Rabbit Doctor】 incorrectly increased critical value instead of critical damage.
[/list][list]
[*] Fixed an issue where switching servers did not retain Couple Channel messages.
[/list]

[h3]Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted Sandswept Wasteland battlefield capacity to 250VS250.
[/list][list]
[*] Opened Elite Monster Training Hall and related quests.
[/list][list]
[*] Adjusted Hao Xiang Tu series title item format and added ability descriptions.
[/list][list]
[*] Adjusted Newbie Seven-Day Reward details and removed Hao Xiang Tu event-related items.
[i]※ For characters that have already completed this, an interface reappearing is a known issue; inability to claim rewards again is normal.[/i]
[/list]

For detailed version update content, please refer to [url=https://www.x-legend.com/online/glorydestiny-reborn/en/news_in.php?nid=24748]Notice from Official Site[/url]

notes.title: ⚠️Mar 26 (Wed) NEW PATCH UPDATE Notice ⚠️
notes.content:
[h2]PATCH UPDATE[/h2]
[h3]Game Update[/h3]
[list]
[*] Level Cap Increase: 60
[/list][list]
[*] New Map Added: Fire Kingdom with its three associated scenes, main quests, achievements, and recommended events.  
[/list][list]
[*] New Daily Dungeon "Revenge of the Sandsea Beasts" added. Players above Lv51 can talk to the local Autonomous Defense Team NPC in Ancient Sandsea (X:111, Y:302) to enter the dungeon. 
※ The dungeon "Jadewood Forest's Crisis" has been adjusted back to its original level restriction of 41~50.
[/list][list]
[*]A new Achievement Badge Purple Gear Blueprint Merchant has been added, allowing players to redeem purple gear blueprints for classes ranging from level 50~60. 
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with the skill 【Dark Matter Explosion】 for Cosmos second advancement where its effect was abnormal.  
[/list][list]
[*] Fixed an issue where some crossbow blueprints could not be used by Astrologer class.
[/list][list]
[*] Fixed an issue where interface countdown timers would remain after leaving a house banquet.
[/list][list]
[*] Fixed an issue where incorrect numbers were displayed in Collection Album at specific point values.
[/list][list]
[*] Fixed an issue where both success and failure results during item synthesis played the same sound effect.
[/list][list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the system display option 【Others' Damage】 was not functioning properly.
[/list][list]
[*] Fixed an issue with the quest "LV47 Defeat Enemy Commander" where mission monsters could not be summoned under certain conditions.
[/list]

[h3]Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted character deletion limit; only up to two characters can be deleted within three days.
[/list][list]
[*] Optimized inventory sorting functionality; clicking the auto-sort button in the inventory interface will now sort items by type.
[/list][list]
[*] World Boss: Seven-Skydemon and Giant Beast series reward mechanisms adjusted.
[/list][list]
[*] In response to the level cap increase, Seven-Skydemon's abilities have been significantly enhanced—please take note!
[/list][list]
[*]Adjusted Pet Search Squad quest requirements and rewards
[/list]

For detailed version update content, please refer to [url=https://www.x-legend.com/online/glorydestiny-reborn/en/news_in.php?nid=24607]Notice from Official Site[/url]
